item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 10/Feb/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong today and tomorrow. Under the persistent influence of a relatively humid easterly airstream, it will be mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches over the coast of southern China midweek this week till the weekend. The weather will be misty at first.

Date/Month: 10/02 (Monday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground at first.
Weather: Mainly fine and dry. Cloudier gradually at night.
Temp range: 13 - 18 C
R.H. range: 45 - 80 per Cent
PSR: Low
